Independent final-source review of the Codex fallback and absent-new-file prerequisite.

The prerequisite changes only repair feedback: still-absent authorized new slots are represented by null in the existing source-version map, while created files retain real Context ContentIdentity values. Current Context is reauthenticated after validation and before feedback. This preserves required-resource loss, unauthorized paths, unexpected occupation and stale-absence refusal. It introduces neither an empty source nor an artificial resource identity. Existing receipts with only present sources remain compatible. The deterministic canonical Checkout fixture first edits an existing resource while a new slot stays absent, receives real failure feedback, then atomically creates/integrates the new module and invokes actual check_changes; host is_current authenticates while installed and rejects after restoration. This is infrastructure evidence, not Qwen inference.

The live task is a genuinely new bounded B-0002 RI increment, qualified before inference against actual APIs and the supported runtime. The Windows case-collision oracle error was caught by private reference qualification before freezing. The frozen oracle e60d40dfa5faf6143703cc8d103db8107a0abdd42475abd341b14d0aa17a9e93 remains unchanged. One genuine Qwen attempt consumed 13 calls, 212304 input/6432 output tokens, 455.694 worker seconds, six proposals and twelve read/check actions. Only the new file was installed; public integration remained missing. The final original disposition REPAIR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and all raw responses/candidates remain immutable. No model-invoked check_changes or is_current occurred. No accepted Qwen algorithm, behavioral repair, review or publication is claimed. Four refusal diagnostics were truthful; raw provider tool arguments match parsed native receipts. The responsible limitation is exact multi-component grounding plus incomplete cross-owner integration, not the corrected absence-feedback defect, invented authority or Context exhaustion.

After authenticated restoration the implementation was written anew by Codex from the public contract and independent pre-inference reference, without transplanting Qwen source. RepositorySnapshotDelta is an immutable difference relationship retaining the supplied snapshots; it is not state, repository identity, ordered mutation history, acquisition, change application or maintenance. Comparison is pure, exact-address and full-occurrence based, deterministic under ordering and Unicode/case, with duplicate-address and repository-mismatch refusal. Public repository and Context reexports are coherent and tested. Absent collection membership makes no physical deletion/rename/copy claim. Broader snapshot policy and RI incremental applicability remain open.

Permanent Codex regressions cover added/removed/modified/unchanged, exact source dependencies, no changes, empty collections, order, retained state after filesystem mutation, case/Unicode, full-value changes despite equal IDs, duplicate input sides, repository mismatch, public exports and immutability. Focused tests, scoped Ruff/format, strict typing across 507 maintained files, layout and Git whitespace checks pass. The final publication recommendation is conditional on the exact installed source/test protected gate passing at 100% production coverage. Worker and candidate hashes are frozen together; the protected result must not be reused after substantive changes.

Existing Checkout and WorkCycle remain the sole source lifecycle/publication owners. Explicit trusted feature-branch publication is authorized; protected-main promotion, backlog approval and parent closure remain prohibited.
